description: Produces a clean, interaction-free SVG RenderFragment for a single WireframePage. This is the shared presentation layer reused by the live canvas and by headless server-side rendering (IWireframeSvgRenderer), so the visual stays in one place and previews cannot drift from the editor. It renders only presentation: the page <svg> root plus connector arrow markers (and an optional grid) in <defs>, the page background, visible connector paths and their labels, and each element as a translated inner-<svg> viewport hosting the component.
